item.title: Consider this your personal invitation
item.description: The International Lightning Class Boat Grant Program is accepting applicants for the 2026 season. This program is geared towards young adult sailors with a minimum age of 19, providing race-winning boats with new sails, new rigging, covers, and an assigned Lightning Class mentor for assistance. item.title: Greatest Yacht Rock songs of all time
item.description: Coined in 2005, Yacht Rock describes the smooth, sophisticated soft rock of the late ’70s and early ’80s. It’s defined by glossy production, clean vocals, and lyrics that bring about images of a life full of leisure. item.title: Winners named for 2025 CCA Awards
item.description: Cruising Club of America (CCA) has awarded the 2025 Blue Water Medal to Pete Hill in addition to five other award winners for their adventurous use of the seas.
